about: The rolling backlog: every piece of work in scope, in one ordered list (operator 2026-10-30 08:26 PT: "a rolling backlog of tickets ... so you (as well as any future windows) have a birds eye view of what needs to be addressed and we can move tickets up or back accordingly dependent on my mandates or what the project needs ... it puts all blocks in scope at once"). Maintained ONLY by the strategic window, at every wave close and whenever the operator moves a ticket. Terminals never edit it; they report in their handoff and the window moves the ticket. A wave's blocks are drawn from the top of NOW and NEXT by lane. Shown on the Visual Dashboard (/visual).
ranking: 5 edge over generality / the betting architecture (10-14)

statuses.NEXT: drawn into the next wave or two
statuses.LATER: in scope, waiting on data, a date or a higher ticket
statuses.PARKED: out of scope until the operator says otherwise
statuses.DONE: closed at a wave close (kept for one wave, then dropped)

lanes.muse: Muse's backlog (TO_MUSE.md); the window aims it
lanes.window: the strategic window's own recurring work
